---
title: "new boxfish script"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(ape)
library(phangorn)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 0. MASTER LOOKUP TABLES (defined once)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

taxonomy <- data.frame(
  species_full = c(
    "Anoplocapros amygdaloides", "Anoplocapros lenticularis", "Anoplocapros inermis",
    "Strophiurichthys robustus", "Aracana aurita", "Aracana ornata",
    "Capropygia unistriata", "Kentrocapros aculeatus", "Polyplacapros tyleri",
    "Acanthostracion guineensis", "Acanthostracion notacanthus",
    "Acanthostracion polygonius", "Acanthostracion quadricornis",
    "Lactophrys bicaudalis", "Lactophrys trigonus", "Lactophrys triqueter",
    "Lactoria cornuta", "Lactoria diaphana", "Lactoria fornasini", "Lactoria paschae",
    "Ostracion cubicus", "Ostracion cyanurus", "Ostracion immaculatus",
    "Ostracion meleagris", "Ostracion nasus", "Rhynchostracion rhinorhynchus",
    "Ostracion solorensis", "Ostracion whitleyi",
    "Tetrosomus concatenatus", "Tetrosomus gibbosus", "Ostracion reipublicae",
    "Triodon macropterus"
  ),
  morpho_code = c(
    NA, "Anoplocapros", NA,
    "Strophiurichthys", "Aracana", NA,
    "Capropygia", "Kentrocapros", "Polyplacapros",
    "acant_guin", "acant_nota", "acant_poly", "acant_quad",
    "lactp_bica", "lactp_trig", "lactp_triq",
    "lacto_corn", "lacto_diap", "lacto_forn", NA,
    "ostr_cubic", "ostr_cyanu", NA, "ostr_melea",
    "ostr_nasus", "Ostr_rhino", NA, "ostr_whitl",
    "tetr_conca", "tetr_gibbo", "tetr_repub",
    "Triodon"
  ),
  mitogenome_accession = c(
    NA, "NC_011319.1", NA,
    NA, NA, NA, NA, "NC_009864.1", NA, NA, NA,
    "PV662072.1", "PV662073.1",
    "OP057014.1", "OP035078.2", NA,
    "NC_057981.1", "NC_011330.1", NA, NA,
    "NC_072284.1", NA, "NC_009865.1", "OP035246.1",
    NA, "NC_030005.1", NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
    "NC_009859.1"
  ),
  ftol_name = c(
    NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
    "Acanthostracion_polygonius", "Acanthostracion_quadricornis",
    "Lactophrys_bicaudalis", "Lactophrys_trigonus", "Rhinesomus_triqueter",
    "Lactoria_cornuta", "Lactoria_diaphana", "Tetrosomus_fornasini", NA,
    "Ostracion_cubicus", NA, "Ostracion_immaculatus", "Ostracion_meleagris",
    "Rhynchostracion_nasus", "Ostracion_rhinorhynchos",
    "Ostracion_solorensis", "Ostracion_whitleyi",
    "Tetrosomus_concatenatus", "Tetrosomus_gibbosus", "Tetrosomus_reipublicae",
    "Triodon_macropterus"
  ),
  family = c(rep("Aracanidae", 9), rep("Ostraciidae", 22), "Triodontidae"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(species_underscore = gsub(" ", "_", species_full))

# Convenience named vectors for fast tip relabelling
acc_to_species  <- setNames(taxonomy$species_full,  taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)
code_to_species <- setNames(taxonomy$species_full,  taxonomy$morpho_code)
acc_to_code     <- setNames(taxonomy$morpho_code,   taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. READ DATA (each file read once)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

morpho_raw <- read.nexus.data("~/Downloads/Boxfish/morpho/Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
morpho_mat <- do.call(rbind, morpho_raw)

dna_data <- read.dna(
  "~/Downloads/Boxfish/muscle_results/muscle-I20260206-203642-0302-71998231-p1m.sqr.fa",
  format = "fasta"
)

mol_aln <- read.dna(
  "~/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/all_mitogenomes_aligned.fasta",
  format = "fasta"
)
rownames(mol_aln) <- gsub(" .*", "", rownames(mol_aln))   # strip to accession

ostrax <- read.dna(
  "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae.phylip",
  format = "sequential"
)

# Extract Triodon from the full FToL alignment and append — save so we never
# have to re-read the large file again
ftol_full <- read.dna(
  "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/final_alignment.phylip",
  format = "interleaved"
)

combined_aln <- rbind(ostrax, ftol_full[grep("Triodon_macropterus", rownames(ftol_full)), ])
rownames(combined_aln)[nrow(combined_aln)] <- "Triodon_macropterus"

write.dna(combined_aln,
          file   = "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae_with_triodon.phylip",
          format = "sequential",
          colsep = "", nbcol = -1)

rm(ftol_full)  # free memory — no longer needed
cat("Saved Ostraciidae_with_triodon.phylip:", nrow(combined_aln), "taxa,",
    ncol(combined_aln), "chars\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. MERGE DNA + LOOKUP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

dna_named <- as.data.frame(as.character(dna_data)) |>
  rownames_to_column("ID") |>
  left_join(taxonomy[, c("mitogenome_accession", "morpho_code")],
            by = c("ID" = "mitogenome_accession")) |>
  filter(!is.na(morpho_code)) |>
  column_to_rownames("morpho_code") |>
  select(-ID)

unmatched <- rownames(as.character(dna_data))[!rownames(as.character(dna_data)) %in% taxonomy$mitogenome_accession]
if (length(unmatched)) message("Unmatched IDs: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))

shared_taxa    <- intersect(rownames(dna_named), rownames(morpho_mat))
message(length(shared_taxa), " shared taxa found")
combined_mat   <- cbind(morpho_mat[shared_taxa, ], dna_named[shared_taxa, ])


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. SPLIT ALIGNMENT INTO LOCI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

aln <- read.dna("~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/Ostraciidae.phylip", format = "sequential")

locus_ranges <- list(
  # Mitochondrial
  s12s      = 1:979,
  s16s      = 980:1756,
  coi       = 2292:2973,
  cytb      = 2974:4114,
  nd2       = 8822:9868,
  nd4       = 9869:11401,
  # Nuclear
  s4c4      = 1757:2291,
  enc1      = 4115:4954,
  ficd      = 4955:5680,
  glyt      = 5681:6613,
  hoxc6a    = 6614:7243,
  kiaa1239  = 7244:7987,
  myh6      = 7988:8821,
  panx2     = 11402:12141,
  plagl2    = 12142:12951,
  ptr       = 12952:13662,
  rag1      = 13663:15116,
  rag2      = 15117:16340,
  rhodopsin = 16341:17264,
  ripk4     = 17265:17909,
  sh3px3    = 17910:18632,
  sidkey    = 18633:19727,
  sreb2     = 19728:20714,
  svep1     = 20715:21521,
  tbr1      = 21522:22349,
  vcpip     = 22350:23114,
  zic1      = 23115:24143
)

mito_loci    <- c("s12s","s16s","coi","cytb","nd2","nd4")
nuclear_loci <- setdiff(names(locus_ranges), mito_loci)

dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito",    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/nuclear", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (nm in names(locus_ranges)) {
  subdir <- if (nm %in% mito_loci) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito" else "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/nuclear"
  fname  <- file.path(subdir, paste0(nm, ".fa"))
  write.dna(aln[, locus_ranges[[nm]]], fname, format = "fasta")
}

message("Done! ", ncol(aln), " total columns split into ", length(locus_ranges),
        " loci across loci/mito/ and loci/nuclear/")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. MITOGENOME TREE — read, root, relabel, plot
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

relabel_tips <- function(tree, lookup_vec) {
  tree$tip.label <- lookup_vec[tree$tip.label]
  tree
}

mito_tree <- read.tree("~/Downloads/Boxfish/trees/boxfish_mito_iqtree.treefile") |>
  relabel_tips(acc_to_species) |>
  (\(t) root(t, grep("Triodon", t$tip.label, value = TRUE), resolve.root = TRUE))()

par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
plot(mito_tree,
     main = "Boxfish Mitogenome Phylogeny (GTR+G, 1000 bootstrap)",
     cex = 0.8, label.offset = 0.005)
nodelabels(mito_tree$node.label,
           cex = 0.6, frame = "none", adj = c(1.2, -0.3), col = "blue")
add.scale.bar()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. MORPHOLOGICAL PARSIMONY TREE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

morpho_phydat <- phyDat(morpho_mat, type = "USER", levels = c("0","1","2","3"))

set.seed(42)
morpho_mp <- pratchet(morpho_phydat, trace = 0, minit = 100, k = 10) |>
  (\(t) root(t, "Aracana", resolve.root = TRUE))()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. PRUNE & COMPARE TREES (shared taxa)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Map mito accessions → morpho codes for the mito tree
mito_tree_coded <- read.tree("~/Downloads/Boxfish/trees/boxfish_mito_iqtree.treefile")
mito_tree_coded$tip.label <- acc_to_code[mito_tree_coded$tip.label]

shared <- intersect(mito_tree_coded$tip.label, names(morpho_raw))
cat("Shared taxa:", length(shared), "\n")

mito_pruned   <- keep.tip(mito_tree_coded, shared)
morpho_pruned <- keep.tip(morpho_mp, shared)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))
plot(morpho_pruned, main = "Morphological Parsimony\n(shared taxa)", cex = 0.8)
plot(mito_pruned,   main = "Mitogenome ML\n(shared taxa)",            cex = 0.8)

# Save morpho tree with accession IDs for MrBayes
morpho_renamed <- morpho_pruned
morpho_renamed$tip.label <- taxonomy$mitogenome_accession[
  match(morpho_renamed$tip.label, taxonomy$morpho_code)
]
write.tree(morpho_renamed, "~/Downloads/Boxfish/trees/morpho_topology.tre")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. BUILD TOTAL-EVIDENCE NEXUS FOR MRBAYES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

all_taxa     <- taxonomy$morpho_code
n_mol_chars  <- ncol(mol_aln)
n_morph_chars <- ncol(morpho_mat)

# Molecular matrix — fill missing with "?"
mol_combined <- matrix("?", nrow = nrow(taxonomy), ncol = n_mol_chars,
                       dimnames = list(all_taxa, NULL))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(taxonomy))) {
  acc <- taxonomy$mitogenome_accession[i]
  if (!is.na(acc) && acc %in% rownames(mol_aln))
    mol_combined[i, ] <- as.character(mol_aln[acc, ])
}

# Morpho matrix — fill missing with "?"
morpho_combined <- matrix("?", nrow = nrow(taxonomy), ncol = n_morph_chars,
                           dimnames = list(all_taxa, NULL))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(taxonomy))) {
  code <- taxonomy$morpho_code[i]
  if (!is.na(code) && code %in% names(morpho_raw))
    morpho_combined[i, ] <- morpho_raw[[code]]
}

n_total     <- n_mol_chars + n_morph_chars
outgrp_name <- all_taxa[grep("riodon", all_taxa, ignore.case = TRUE)]

con <- file("~/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex", "w")
writeLines(c(
  "#NEXUS", "",
  "begin data;",
  paste0("  dimensions ntax=", nrow(taxonomy), " nchar=", n_total, ";"),
  paste0("  format datatype=mixed(dna:1-", n_mol_chars,
         ", standard:", n_mol_chars + 1, "-", n_total,
         ") interleave=no missing=? gap=-;"),
  "  matrix"
), con)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(taxonomy))) {
  writeLines(paste0("  ", all_taxa[i], "  ",
                    paste(mol_combined[i,],    collapse = ""),
                    paste(morpho_combined[i,], collapse = "")), con)
}

writeLines(c(
  "  ;", "end;", "",
  "begin mrbayes;",
  "  set autoclose=yes nowarn=yes;", "",
  paste0("  charset molecular = 1-", n_mol_chars, ";"),
  paste0("  charset morpho = ", n_mol_chars + 1, "-", n_total, ";"),
  "  partition totalevidence = 2: molecular, morpho;",
  "  set partition = totalevidence;", "",
  "  lset applyto=(1) nst=6 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;",
  "  lset applyto=(2) nst=1 rates=gamma ngammacat=4 coding=variable;", "",
  "  prset applyto=(1) statefreqpr=dirichlet(1,1,1,1);",
  "  prset applyto=(2) symdirihyperpr=fixed(infinity);",
  "  prset applyto=(all) ratepr=variable;", "",
  "  unlink statefreq=(all) revmat=(all) shape=(all);", "",
  paste0("  outgroup ", outgrp_name, ";"),
  "  mcmc ngen=2000000 nchains=4 nruns=2",
  "       samplefreq=500 printfreq=500",
  "       savebrlens=yes filename=boxfish_total;",
  "  sump burnin=500;",
  "  sumt burnin=500;",
  "end;"
), con)
close(con)

cat("Total-evidence nexus written.\n")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 8. THREE-TREE COMPARISON PLOT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

nuclear_tree <- read.tree("~/Downloads/Boxfish/ftol/nuclear_iqtree.treefile") |>
  (\(t) root(t, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE))()
nuclear_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", nuclear_tree$tip.label)

morpho_tree <- read.tree("~/Downloads/Boxfish/trees/morpho_topology.tre") |>
  relabel_tips(acc_to_species) |>
  (\(t) root(t, "Kentrocapros aculeatus", resolve.root = TRUE))()

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(mito_tree,    main = "Mitogenome (IQ-TREE)",        cex = 0.7)
nodelabels(mito_tree$node.label,    cex = 0.5, frame = "none", adj = c(1.2, -0.3))
plot(nuclear_tree, main = "Nuclear loci (IQ-TREE)",      cex = 0.7)
nodelabels(nuclear_tree$node.label, cex = 0.5, frame = "none", adj = c(1.2, -0.3))
plot(morpho_tree,  main = "Morphology (Parsimony)",      cex = 0.7)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 10. DATA COVERAGE HEATMAP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

mito_species    <- na.omit(taxonomy$species_full[!is.na(taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)])
ftol_species    <- gsub("_", " ", na.omit(taxonomy$ftol_name))
morpho_species  <- na.omit(taxonomy$species_full[!is.na(taxonomy$morpho_code)])
target_species  <- taxonomy$species_full

coverage <- taxonomy |>
  transmute(
    Species      = species_full,
    Mitogenome   = species_full %in% mito_species,
    FToL_nuclear = species_full %in% ftol_species,
    Morphology   = species_full %in% morpho_species
  )

coverage |>
  pivot_longer(-Species, names_to = "Data_type", values_to = "Present") |>
  mutate(
    Data_type = factor(Data_type, levels = c("Mitogenome","FToL_nuclear","Morphology")),
    Species   = factor(Species, levels = rev(target_species))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Data_type, y = Species, fill = Present)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2d6a4f", "FALSE" = "#f0f0f0"),
                    labels  = c("TRUE" = "Present", "FALSE" = "Absent")) +
  labs(title = "Data coverage across taxa", x = "", y = "", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 9. NCBI COVERAGE HEATMAP (load pre-computed results)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Previously saved by the rentrez search — no need to re-run
coverage_ncbi <- read.csv("~/Downloads/Boxfish/ncbi_coverage.csv",
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

locus_order <- c(
  "COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4","ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6",
  "COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8",
  "4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6","panx2","plagl2",
  "ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4","sh3px3","sidkey","sreb2",
  "svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1"
)

coverage_ncbi |>
  mutate(
    locus   = factor(locus,   levels = locus_order),
    species = factor(species, levels = rev(target_species))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = locus, y = species, fill = found)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2d6a4f", "FALSE" = "#f0f0f0"),
                    labels  = c("TRUE" = "Present", "FALSE" = "Absent")) +
  labs(title = "NCBI data availability across taxa and loci",
       x = "", y = "", fill = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8))

```
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 10. DATA COVERAGE BY SOURCE HEATMAP
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 
# For each species × locus, determine the best available source:
# Mitogenome > FToL > NCBI only > Missing
 
mito_locus_names <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                       "ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6","COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8")
ftol_locus_names <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                       "4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6","panx2",
                       "plagl2","ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4","sh3px3",
                       "sidkey","sreb2","svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1")
 
ftol_taxa_species <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(ostrax))
mito_taxa_species <- na.omit(taxonomy$species_full[!is.na(taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)])
 
coverage_source <- coverage_ncbi |>
  mutate(
    has_mitogenome = species %in% mito_taxa_species & locus %in% mito_locus_names,
    has_ftol       = species %in% ftol_taxa_species & locus %in% ftol_locus_names,
    source = case_when(
      has_mitogenome ~ "Mitogenome",
      has_ftol       ~ "FToL",
      found          ~ "NCBI only",
      TRUE           ~ "Missing"
    ),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("Mitogenome", "FToL", "NCBI only", "Missing"))
  )
 
locus_type <- data.frame(
  locus = locus_order,
  type  = c(rep("mtDNA", 15), rep("nuDNA", 21)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
 
coverage_source |>
  left_join(locus_type, by = "locus") |>
  mutate(
    locus   = factor(locus,   levels = locus_order),
    species = factor(species, levels = rev(target_species)),
    type    = factor(type,    levels = c("mtDNA", "nuDNA"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = locus, y = species, fill = source)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mitogenome" = "#2d6a4f",
      "FToL"       = "#52b788",
      "NCBI only"  = "#f4a261",
      "Missing"    = "#f0f0f0"
    )
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Data coverage by source", x = "", y = "", fill = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
        strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 10. DATA COVERAGE BY SOURCE HEATMAP + COUNTS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

mito_locus_names <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                       "ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6","COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8")
ftol_locus_names <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                       "4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6","panx2",
                       "plagl2","ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4","sh3px3",
                       "sidkey","sreb2","svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1")

ftol_taxa_species <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(ostrax))
mito_taxa_species <- na.omit(taxonomy$species_full[!is.na(taxonomy$mitogenome_accession)])

locus_type <- data.frame(
  locus = locus_order,
  type  = c(rep("mtDNA", 15), rep("nuDNA", 21)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coverage_source <- coverage_ncbi |>
  mutate(
    has_mitogenome = species %in% mito_taxa_species & locus %in% mito_locus_names,
    has_ftol       = species %in% ftol_taxa_species & locus %in% ftol_locus_names,
    source = case_when(
      has_mitogenome ~ "Mitogenome",
      has_ftol       ~ "FToL",
      found          ~ "NCBI only",
      TRUE           ~ "Missing"
    ),
    source = factor(source, levels = c("Mitogenome", "FToL", "NCBI only", "Missing"))
  )

# Count taxa per locus (non-missing)
locus_counts <- coverage_source |>
  filter(source != "Missing") |>
  count(locus, name = "n_taxa")

coverage_source |>
  left_join(locus_type, by = "locus") |>
  left_join(locus_counts, by = "locus") |>
  mutate(
    locus_label = paste0(locus, "\n(n=", n_taxa, ")"),
    # preserve ordering
    locus_label = factor(locus_label, 
                         levels = unique(locus_label[order(match(locus, locus_order))])),
    species = factor(species, levels = rev(target_species)),
    type    = factor(type,    levels = c("mtDNA", "nuDNA"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = locus_label, y = species, fill = source)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mitogenome" = "#2d6a4f",
      "FToL"       = "#52b788",
      "NCBI only"  = "#f4a261",
      "Missing"    = "#f0f0f0"
    )
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ type, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Data coverage by source", x = "", y = "", fill = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
        strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
library(rentrez)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Helper: fetch one accession and return as named char string
fetch_seq <- function(accession, species, delay = 0.34) {
  result <- tryCatch(
    entrez_fetch(db = "nucleotide", id = accession,
                 rettype = "fasta", retmode = "text"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  Sys.sleep(delay)
  if (is.null(result)) return(NULL)

  # Replace the NCBI header with a clean species name
  clean_name <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
  sub(">\\S+[^\n]*", paste0(">", clean_name), result)
}

# Download and write per locus
loci <- unique(to_download$locus)
cat("Downloading sequences for", nrow(to_download), "species × locus combinations\n")

for (loc in loci) {

  rows <- to_download[to_download$locus == loc, ]

  seqs <- mapply(fetch_seq,
                 accession = rows$accession,
                 species   = rows$species,
                 SIMPLIFY  = FALSE)
  seqs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), seqs)

  if (length(seqs) == 0) next

  # Determine output directory
  mito_loci <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                  "ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6","COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8")
  subdir <- if (loc %in% mito_loci) {
    "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito"

    "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/nuclear"
  }
  dir.create(subdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  outfile <- file.path(subdir, paste0(tolower(loc), "_ncbi.fa"))
  writeLines(unlist(seqs), outfile)
  cat("Wrote", length(seqs), "sequences →", outfile, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MERGE PER-LOCUS FASTAS WITH SOURCE PRIORITY + RICH HEADERS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(ape)
library(tidyverse)

canonical_taxa <- c(
  "Anoplocapros amygdaloides", "Anoplocapros lenticularis", "Anoplocapros inermis",
  "Strophiurichthys robustus", "Aracana aurita", "Aracana ornata",
  "Capropygia unistriata", "Kentrocapros aculeatus", "Polyplacapros tyleri",
  "Acanthostracion guineensis", "Acanthostracion notacanthus",
  "Acanthostracion polygonius", "Acanthostracion quadricornis",
  "Lactophrys bicaudalis", "Lactophrys trigonus", "Lactophrys triqueter",
  "Lactoria cornuta", "Lactoria diaphana", "Lactoria fornasini", "Lactoria paschae",
  "Ostracion cubicus", "Ostracion cyanurus", "Ostracion immaculatus",
  "Ostracion meleagris", "Ostracion nasus", "Rhynchostracion rhinorhynchus",
  "Ostracion solorensis", "Ostracion whitleyi",
  "Tetrosomus concatenatus", "Tetrosomus gibbosus", "Ostracion reipublicae",
  "Triodon macropterus"
)

synonyms <- c(
  "Ostracion rhinorhynchos"   = "Rhynchostracion rhinorhynchus",
  "Ostracion rhinorhynchus"   = "Rhynchostracion rhinorhynchus",
  "Strophiurichthys robustus" = "Anoplocapros inermis",
  "Tetrosomus reipublicae"    = "Ostracion reipublicae",
  "Lactoria paschae"          = "Lactoria diaphana",
  "Acanthostracion guineense" = "Acanthostracion guineensis",
  "Rhinesomus triqueter"      = "Lactophrys triqueter",
  "Tetrosomus fornasini"      = "Lactoria fornasini"
)

canonicalize <- function(name) {
  name <- trimws(gsub("_", " ", name))
  ifelse(name %in% names(synonyms), synonyms[name], name)
}

# Strip alignment gaps and return named list of raw sequences
read_fasta_list <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(list())
  lines <- readLines(path)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  mapply(function(s, e) {
    paste(gsub("-", "", lines[s:e]), collapse = "")
  },
  idx + 1,
  c(idx[-1] - 1, length(lines)),
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE) |>
    setNames(sub("^>", "", lines[idx]))
}

mito_loci_names    <- c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4",
                         "ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6","COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8")
nuclear_loci_names <- c("4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6","panx2",
                         "plagl2","ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4","sh3px3",
                         "sidkey","sreb2","svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1")
all_loci <- c(mito_loci_names, nuclear_loci_names)

# ncbi accession lookup per species × locus
ncbi_acc <- coverage_ncbi |>
  filter(found == TRUE) |>
  mutate(species = canonicalize(species)) |>
  select(species, locus, accession)

# ftol accession lookup — use ftol_name from taxonomy as the accession label
ftol_acc <- taxonomy |>
  filter(!is.na(ftol_name)) |>
  select(species_full, ftol_name) |>
  deframe()  # named vector: species_full -> ftol_name

dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/mito",    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/nuclear", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (loc in all_loci) {

  is_mito <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  subdir  <- if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/mito" else
                           "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/nuclear"

  # File name convention: lowercase locus
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)

  # Read FToL sequences (gap-stripped)
  ftol_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito" else "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, ".fa")
  )
  ftol_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ftol_path)
  names(ftol_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ftol_seqs))

  # Read NCBI sequences (gap-stripped)
  ncbi_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito" else "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, "_ncbi.fa")
  )
  ncbi_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ncbi_path)
  names(ncbi_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ncbi_seqs))

  # Build one entry per canonical taxon
  out_lines <- c()

  for (sp in canonical_taxa) {

    sp_under <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)

    # Collect all available sequences with source labels
    candidates <- list()

    if (sp %in% names(ftol_seqs) && nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      acc <- if (!is.na(ftol_acc[sp])) ftol_acc[sp] else "FToL"
      candidates[["FToL"]] <- list(seq = ftol_seqs[[sp]],
                                    acc = acc,
                                    len = nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]))
    }

    if (sp %in% names(ncbi_seqs) && nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      acc <- ncbi_acc$accession[ncbi_acc$species == sp & ncbi_acc$locus == loc]
      acc <- if (length(acc) > 0) acc[1] else "NCBI"
      candidates[["NCBI"]] <- list(seq = ncbi_seqs[[sp]],
                                    acc = acc,
                                    len = nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]]))
    }

    if (length(candidates) == 0) {
      # No data — write empty entry
      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under, " [source=MISSING] [accession=NA]"),
                     "")
      next
    }

    # Pick longest sequence
    best_source <- names(which.max(sapply(candidates, `[[`, "len")))
    best        <- candidates[[best_source]]

    header <- paste0(">", sp_under,
                     " [source=", best_source, "]",
                     " [accession=", best$acc, "]",
                     " [len=", best$len, "]")
    out_lines <- c(out_lines, header, best$seq)
  }

  outfile <- file.path(subdir, paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  writeLines(out_lines, outfile)
  n_present <- sum(sapply(canonical_taxa, function(sp) {
    any(grepl(paste0(">", gsub(" ", "_", sp), " \\[source=(?!MISSING)"), out_lines, perl = TRUE))
  }))
  cat(sprintf("%-12s %d/%d taxa\n", loc, n_present, length(canonical_taxa)))
}

cat("\nDone. Merged fastas in ~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/\n")
```

take the ref coordinates for each locus above from O. immaculatus and run through each mitogenome

```{r}
library(ape)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)

maf_dir <- "~/Downloads/Boxfish/lastz_out"
rev_comp <- function(seq) {
  comp <- chartr("ACGTacgt", "TGCAtgca", seq)
  paste(rev(strsplit(comp, "")[[1]]), collapse = "")
}

# Parse a MAF file and return a data frame of alignment blocks
parse_maf <- function(filepath) {
  lines   <- readLines(filepath)
  a_lines <- which(startsWith(lines, "a "))
  
  blocks <- lapply(a_lines, function(i) {
    s_lines <- lines[(i+1):(i+2)]
    s_lines <- s_lines[startsWith(s_lines, "s ")]
    if (length(s_lines) < 2) return(NULL)
    
    parse_s <- function(l) {
      p <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
      list(src    = p[2],
           start  = as.integer(p[3]),  # 0-based
           size   = as.integer(p[4]),
           strand = p[5],
           srclen = as.integer(p[6]),
           seq    = p[7])
    }
    list(ref   = parse_s(s_lines[1]),
         query = parse_s(s_lines[2]))
  })
  Filter(Negate(is.null), blocks)
}

# Extract a locus sequence from MAF blocks given ref coordinates (1-based)
extract_locus_from_maf <- function(blocks, ref_start, ref_end, strand) {
  # find block(s) overlapping the locus
  seq_parts <- c()
  
  for (b in blocks) {
    r <- b$ref
    # MAF is 0-based half-open
    blk_start <- r$start + 1        # convert to 1-based
    blk_end   <- r$start + r$size
    
    if (blk_end < ref_start || blk_start > ref_end) next
    
    # Overlap region in reference coordinates
    ov_start <- max(ref_start, blk_start)
    ov_end   <- min(ref_end,   blk_end)
    
    # Map to alignment column positions
    ref_seq <- strsplit(r$seq, "")[[1]]
    qry_seq <- strsplit(b$query$seq, "")[[1]]
    
    # Walk ref sequence to find columns corresponding to overlap
    ref_pos  <- blk_start - 1
    col_keep <- c()
    for (col in seq_along(ref_seq)) {
      if (ref_seq[col] != "-") {
        ref_pos <- ref_pos + 1
        if (ref_pos >= ov_start && ref_pos <= ov_end) {
          col_keep <- c(col_keep, col)
        }
      }
    }
    seq_parts <- c(seq_parts, qry_seq[col_keep])
  }
  
  if (length(seq_parts) == 0) return(NULL)
  seq_out <- paste(seq_parts[seq_parts != "-"], collapse = "")
  
  # Reverse complement if on minus strand
  if (strand == "-") {
    seq_out <- rev_comp(seq_out)
  }
  seq_out
}

# Species name from MAF filename
maf_to_species <- function(fname) {
  sp <- gsub("_vs_ref\\.maf$", "", basename(fname))
  sp <- gsub("_mitogenome.*", "", sp)
  sp <- gsub("_", " ", sp)
  # remove accession suffix (last word if it looks like an accession)
  sp <- gsub("\\s+[A-Z0-9_.]+$", "", sp)
  trimws(sp)
}

# Run extraction for all mitogenomes × all loci
maf_files <- list.files(maf_dir, pattern = "\\.maf$", full.names = TRUE)

dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito_extracted", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (loc in ref_coords$locus) {
  coords <- ref_coords[ref_coords$locus == loc, ]
  out_lines <- c()
  
  for (maf_file in maf_files) {
    sp      <- maf_to_species(maf_file)
    sp_can  <- canonicalize(sp)
    blocks  <- parse_maf(maf_file)
    
    if (length(blocks) == 0) next
    
    seq_out <- extract_locus_from_maf(blocks,
                                       coords$start,
                                       coords$end,
                                       coords$strand)
    if (is.null(seq_out) || nchar(seq_out) == 0) next
    
    sp_under <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_can)
    out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                   paste0(">", sp_under,
                          " [source=Mitogenome]",
                          " [accession=", gsub(".*_([A-Z0-9_.]+)\\.maf", "\\1",
                                               basename(maf_file)), "]",
                          " [len=", nchar(seq_out), "]"),
                   seq_out)
  }
  
  if (length(out_lines) > 0) {
    outfile <- paste0("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito_extracted/",
                      tolower(loc), "_mito.fa")
    writeLines(out_lines, outfile)
    cat(sprintf("%-8s %d sequences extracted\n",
                loc, sum(startsWith(out_lines, ">"))))
  }
}

cat("Done. Extracted loci in ~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito_extracted/\n")
```

```{r}
rev_comp <- function(seq) {
  comp <- chartr("ACGTacgt", "TGCAtgca", seq)
  paste(rev(strsplit(comp, "")[[1]]), collapse = "")
}

parse_maf <- function(filepath) {
  lines   <- readLines(filepath)
  a_lines <- which(startsWith(lines, "a "))
  blocks  <- lapply(a_lines, function(i) {
    # collect the two s-lines after this a-line
    s_idx <- which(startsWith(lines[(i+1):min(i+10, length(lines))], "s "))
    if (length(s_idx) < 2) return(NULL)
    s_idx <- s_idx + i  # absolute indices
    parse_s <- function(l) {
      p <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
      list(start  = as.integer(p[3]),   # 0-based
           size   = as.integer(p[4]),
           strand = p[5],
           srclen = as.integer(p[6]),
           seq    = p[7])
    }
    list(ref   = parse_s(lines[s_idx[1]]),
         query = parse_s(lines[s_idx[2]]))
  })
  Filter(Negate(is.null), blocks)
}

extract_locus_from_maf <- function(blocks, locus_start, locus_end, strand) {
  # locus_start and locus_end are 1-based coordinates on the reference
  collected <- c()

  for (b in blocks) {
    r <- b$ref
    q <- b$query

    # MAF start is 0-based — convert to 1-based
    blk_start_1 <- r$start + 1
    blk_end_1   <- r$start + r$size   # last ref base in this block (1-based)

    # Skip blocks that don't overlap the locus at all
    if (blk_end_1 < locus_start || blk_start_1 > locus_end) next

    # Overlap in 1-based ref coordinates
    ov_start <- max(locus_start, blk_start_1)
    ov_end   <- min(locus_end,   blk_end_1)

    ref_chars <- strsplit(r$seq, "")[[1]]
    qry_chars <- strsplit(q$seq, "")[[1]]

    # Walk column by column
    # ref_pos tracks current 1-based position in the reference (gaps don't advance it)
    ref_pos <- blk_start_1 - 1  # will be incremented before use

    for (col in seq_along(ref_chars)) {
      if (ref_chars[col] != "-") {
        ref_pos <- ref_pos + 1
        if (ref_pos >= ov_start && ref_pos <= ov_end) {
          # Only keep query base if it's not a gap
          if (qry_chars[col] != "-") {
            collected <- c(collected, qry_chars[col])
          }
        }
        # Past the locus — no need to keep walking
        if (ref_pos > ov_end) break
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(collected) == 0) return(NULL)

  seq_out <- paste(collected, collapse = "")

  if (strand == "-") seq_out <- rev_comp(seq_out)

  seq_out
}

# Gene coordinates from NC_009865.1

             8793, 9650, 10069,10359,11954,13789,14385),
  end    = c(1017, 2781, 3828, 5088, 7030, 7875, 8119, 8792,
             9577, 9998, 10365,11739,13792,14310,15525),
  strand = c("+","+","+","+","+","+","+","+",
```

take data from mitogenomes, ftol, and ncbi and merge them picking the longest

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MERGE PER-LOCUS FASTAS: MITO EXTRACTED + FTOL + NCBI
# Priority: Mitogenome always first, then FToL vs NCBI whichever longer
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

for (loc in all_loci) {

  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  subdir    <- if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/mito" else
                             "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/nuclear"
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)

  # ── 1. Read mitogenome extracted ────────────────────────────────────
  mito_ext_seqs <- list()
  mito_ext_acc  <- list()

  if (is_mito) {
    mito_ext_path <- paste0("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/mito_extracted/",
                             loc_lower, "_mito.fa")
    if (file.exists(mito_ext_path)) {
      raw_lines <- readLines(mito_ext_path)
      idx <- which(startsWith(raw_lines, ">"))
      for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
        header  <- sub("^>", "", raw_lines[idx[i]])
        seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(raw_lines)
        seq     <- paste(raw_lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
        sp_can  <- canonicalize(sub(" \\[.*", "", header))
        mito_ext_seqs[[sp_can]] <- seq
        mito_ext_acc[[sp_can]]  <- parse_header_accession(header)
      }
    }
  }

  # ── 2. Read FToL (gap-stripped) ─────────────────────────────────────
  ftol_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ftol_mito" else
                 "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ftol_nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, ".fa")
  )
  ftol_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ftol_path)
  names(ftol_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ftol_seqs))

  # ── 3. Read NCBI ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ncbi_path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ncbi_mito" else
                 "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ncbi_nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, "_ncbi.fa")
  )
  ncbi_seqs <- read_fasta_list(ncbi_path)
  names(ncbi_seqs) <- canonicalize(names(ncbi_seqs))

  # ── Build one entry per canonical taxon ─────────────────────────────
  out_lines <- c()

  for (sp in canonical_taxa) {

    sp_under <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)

    # Mitogenome always wins if available
    if (sp %in% names(mito_ext_seqs) && nchar(mito_ext_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under,
                            " [source=Mitogenome]",
                            " [accession=", mito_ext_acc[[sp]], "]",
                            " [len=", nchar(mito_ext_seqs[[sp]]), "]"),
                     mito_ext_seqs[[sp]])
      next
    }

    # FToL vs NCBI — pick longer, filter NCBI full mitogenomes
    candidates <- list()

    if (sp %in% names(ftol_seqs) && nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      acc <- if (!is.na(ftol_acc[sp])) ftol_acc[sp] else "FToL"
      candidates[["FToL"]] <- list(seq = ftol_seqs[[sp]],
                                    acc = acc,
                                    len = nchar(ftol_seqs[[sp]]))
    }

    if (sp %in% names(ncbi_seqs) && nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]]) > 0) {
      raw_len <- nchar(ncbi_seqs[[sp]])
      if (raw_len < 10000) {
        acc <- ncbi_acc$accession[ncbi_acc$species == sp &
                                    ncbi_acc$locus == loc]
        acc <- if (length(acc) > 0) acc[1] else "NCBI"
        candidates[["NCBI"]] <- list(seq = ncbi_seqs[[sp]],
                                      acc = acc,
                                      len = raw_len)
      }
    }

    if (length(candidates) == 0) {
      out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                     paste0(">", sp_under,
                            " [source=MISSING] [accession=NA] [len=0]"),
                     "")
      next
    }

    best_source <- names(which.max(sapply(candidates, `[[`, "len")))
    best        <- candidates[[best_source]]

    out_lines <- c(out_lines,
                   paste0(">", sp_under,
                          " [source=", best_source, "]",
                          " [accession=", best$acc, "]",
                          " [len=", best$len, "]"),
                   best$seq)
  }

  outfile <- file.path(subdir, paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  writeLines(out_lines, outfile)

  n_present <- sum(grepl("source=(?!MISSING)", out_lines, perl = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("%-10s %d/%d taxa\n", loc, n_present, length(canonical_taxa)))
}

cat("\nDone. Merged fastas in ~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ALIGN PER-LOCUS FASTAS WITH MAFFT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

mafft_path <- "/opt/miniconda3/bin/mafft"

dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/mito",    recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/nuclear", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (loc in all_loci) {

  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)

  in_dir  <- if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/mito" else
                           "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/merged/nuclear"
  out_dir <- if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/mito" else
                           "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/nuclear"

  infile  <- file.path(in_dir,  paste0(loc_lower, ".fa"))
  outfile <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(loc_lower, "_aligned.fa"))

  if (!file.exists(infile)) {
    cat(sprintf("%-10s SKIPPED (file not found)\n", loc))
    next
  }

  lines <- readLines(infile)

  # Strip MISSING and full mitogenomes, keep only alignable sequences
  non_missing <- c()
  idx <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))

  for (i in seq_along(idx)) {
    header  <- lines[idx[i]]
    seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(lines)
    seq     <- trimws(paste(lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = ""))

    if (grepl("MISSING", header)) next
    if (nchar(seq) == 0)          next
    if (nchar(seq) > 10000) {
      cat(sprintf("  SKIPPING full mitogenome: %s (%d bp)\n",
                  sub(" .*", "", header), nchar(seq)))
      next
    }
    non_missing <- c(non_missing, header, seq)
  }

  if (length(non_missing) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("%-10s SKIPPED (no alignable sequences)\n", loc))
    next
  }

  if (sum(startsWith(non_missing, ">")) < 2) {
    cat(sprintf("%-10s SKIPPED (only 1 sequence)\n", loc))
    next
  }

  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".fa")
  writeLines(non_missing, tmp)

  cmd <- sprintf("%s --auto --adjustdirectionaccurately --thread -1 %s > %s 2>/dev/null",
                 mafft_path, tmp, outfile)
  ret <- system(cmd)

  if (ret == 0) {
    n_seqs <- sum(startsWith(readLines(outfile), ">"))
    cat(sprintf("%-10s %d taxa aligned\n", loc, n_seqs))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("%-10s ERROR (mafft returned %d)\n", loc, ret))
  }

  file.remove(tmp)
}

cat("\nDone. Aligned fastas in ~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SANITY CHECK ALIGNED LOCI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(ape)

results <- lapply(all_loci, function(loc) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  aln_dir   <- if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/mito" else
                             "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/nuclear"
  aln_file  <- file.path(aln_dir, paste0(loc_lower, "_aligned.fa"))

  if (!file.exists(aln_file)) {
    return(data.frame(locus=loc, n_taxa=0, aln_len=NA,
                      min_len=NA, max_len=NA, n_missing=NA,
                      sources=NA, status="FILE MISSING"))
  }

  aln   <- read.dna(aln_file, format="fasta")
  lines <- readLines(aln_file)
  headers <- lines[startsWith(lines, ">")]

  # Sequence lengths without gaps
  raw_lens <- apply(as.character(aln), 1, function(x)
    sum(x != "-" & x != "?"))

  # Sources
  sources <- regmatches(headers,
                        regexpr("(?<=\\[source=)[^\\]]+", headers, perl=TRUE))
  source_tab <- table(sources)

  # How many canonical taxa are missing
  taxa_present <- gsub(" \\[.*", "", sub("^>", "", headers))
  taxa_present <- gsub("_", " ", taxa_present)
  n_missing    <- sum(!canonical_taxa %in% taxa_present)

  data.frame(
    locus    = loc,
    n_taxa   = nrow(aln),
    aln_len  = ncol(aln),
    min_len  = min(raw_lens),
    max_len  = max(raw_lens),
    n_missing = n_missing,
    sources  = paste(names(source_tab), source_tab, sep="=", collapse=" | "),
    status   = ifelse(min(raw_lens) > 0, "OK", "HAS EMPTY SEQ"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

report <- do.call(rbind, results)
print(report, row.names = FALSE)

# Flag anything suspicious
cat("\n── Potential issues ──────────────────────────────────────────\n")
if (any(report$status != "OK" & report$status != "FILE MISSING"))
  cat("Empty sequences in:", paste(report$locus[report$status != "OK"], collapse=", "), "\n")
if (any(report$n_taxa < 5))
  cat("Low taxa count (<5):", paste(report$locus[report$n_taxa < 5], collapse=", "), "\n")
if (any((report$max_len / report$min_len) > 3, na.rm=TRUE))
  cat("High length variation (>3x):", 
      paste(report$locus[(report$max_len / report$min_len) > 3], collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
```

```{r}
check_ftol_content <- function(loc) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  path <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ftol_mito" else
                 "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/ftol_nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, ".fa")
  )
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  
  lines <- readLines(path)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))
  
  lapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    header  <- sub("^>", "", lines[idx[i]])
    seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(lines)
    seq     <- paste(lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
    # strip gaps AND spaces (ape writes sequences with spaces)
    raw     <- gsub("[-\\? ]", "", seq)
    data.frame(
      locus    = loc,
      taxon    = canonicalize(header),
      raw_len  = nchar(raw),
      has_data = nchar(raw) >= 100
    )
  }) |> do.call(what = rbind)
}

ftol_content <- lapply(all_loci, check_ftol_content) |>
  do.call(what = rbind)

ftol_content |>
  group_by(locus) |>
  summarise(has_data = sum(has_data), all_gaps = sum(!has_data)) |>
  print(n = 40)
```

now the seqs are exploded by locus but not every taxon is in every locus file. fix this by adding in ?? where there is no data
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ADD MISSING TAXA AS ? SEQUENCES TO ALIGNED FILES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

for (loc in all_loci) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  aln_file  <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/mito" else
                 "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, "_aligned.fa")
  )

  if (!file.exists(aln_file)) next

  lines <- readLines(aln_file)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))

  # Get alignment length from first sequence
  seq_end   <- if (length(idx) > 1) idx[2] - 1 else length(lines)
  first_seq <- paste(lines[(idx[1]+1):seq_end], collapse="")
  aln_len   <- nchar(first_seq)

  # Get taxa already present
  present <- gsub(" \\[.*","", sub("^>","", lines[idx]))
  present <- gsub("_"," ", present)

  # Find missing canonical taxa
  missing <- canonical_taxa[!canonical_taxa %in% present]

  if (length(missing) == 0) next

  # Append missing taxa as ? strings
  new_lines <- c(lines)
  for (sp in missing) {
    new_lines <- c(new_lines,
                   paste0(">", gsub(" ","_",sp),
                          " [source=MISSING] [accession=NA] [len=0]"),
                   paste(rep("?", aln_len), collapse=""))
  }

  writeLines(new_lines, aln_file)
  cat(sprintf("%-10s added %d missing taxa (aln_len=%d)\n",
              loc, length(missing), aln_len))
}

cat("\nDone.\n")
```

now build a supermatrix
```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD SUPERMATRIX: MITO + NUCLEAR + MORPHO
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(ape)
dir.create("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── 1. Read all aligned loci ─────────────────────────────────────────

read_aligned <- function(loc) {
  is_mito   <- loc %in% mito_loci_names
  loc_lower <- tolower(loc)
  aln_file  <- file.path(
    if (is_mito) "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/mito" else
                 "~/Downloads/Boxfish/loci/aligned/nuclear",
    paste0(loc_lower, "_aligned.fa")
  )
  if (!file.exists(aln_file)) return(NULL)

  lines <- readLines(aln_file)
  idx   <- which(startsWith(lines, ">"))

  seqs <- lapply(seq_along(idx), function(i) {
    seq_end <- if (i < length(idx)) idx[i+1] - 1 else length(lines)
    seq     <- paste(lines[(idx[i]+1):seq_end], collapse = "")
    # convert MISSING ? strings and gaps to ?
    seq <- gsub(" ", "", seq)
    seq
  })
  names(seqs) <- gsub(" \\[.*","", sub("^>","", lines[idx]))
  names(seqs) <- gsub("_"," ", names(seqs))
  seqs
}

# ── 2. Build per-locus matrices (32 taxa × aln_len) ──────────────────

partition_info <- list()
col_start      <- 1
matrices       <- list()

for (loc in all_loci) {
  seqs <- read_aligned(loc)
  if (is.null(seqs)) next

  aln_len <- nchar(seqs[[1]])

  # Build matrix — every canonical taxon gets a row
  mat <- sapply(canonical_taxa, function(sp) {
    if (sp %in% names(seqs)) {
      strsplit(seqs[[sp]], "")[[1]]
    } else {
      rep("?", aln_len)
    }
  })
  mat <- t(mat)  # taxa × sites

  matrices[[loc]] <- mat

  partition_info[[loc]] <- list(
    start  = col_start,
    end    = col_start + aln_len - 1,
    type   = if (loc %in% mito_loci_names) "mtDNA" else "nuDNA"
  )
  col_start <- col_start + aln_len
}

# ── 3. Add morpho matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────

morpho_raw  <- read.nexus.data(
  "~/Downloads/Boxfish/morpho/Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
n_morpho    <- length(morpho_raw[[1]])

morpho_mat <- t(sapply(canonical_taxa, function(sp) {
  code <- names(morpho_to_canonical)[morpho_to_canonical == sp]
  if (length(code) > 0 && code %in% names(morpho_raw)) {
    morpho_raw[[code]]
  } else {
    rep("?", n_morpho)
  }
}))

matrices[["Morphology"]] <- morpho_mat
partition_info[["Morphology"]] <- list(
  start = col_start,
  end   = col_start + n_morpho - 1,
  type  = "Morphology"
)

# ── 4. Concatenate all matrices ───────────────────────────────────────

supermatrix <- do.call(cbind, matrices)
rownames(supermatrix) <- gsub(" ", "_", canonical_taxa)

cat("Supermatrix dimensions:", nrow(supermatrix), "taxa x",
    ncol(supermatrix), "characters\n")

# ── 5. Write NEXUS with partition info ───────────────────────────────

n_total <- ncol(supermatrix)
n_taxa  <- nrow(supermatrix)

con <- file("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/supermatrix.nex", "w")

writeLines(c(
  "#NEXUS", "",
  "begin data;",
  paste0("  dimensions ntax=", n_taxa, " nchar=", n_total, ";"),
  paste0("  format datatype=mixed(",
         "dna:1-", partition_info[["Morphology"]]$start - 1, ",",
         "standard:", partition_info[["Morphology"]]$start, "-", n_total,
         ") interleave=no missing=? gap=-;"),
  "  matrix"
), con)

for (i in seq_len(n_taxa)) {
  writeLines(paste0("  ", rownames(supermatrix)[i], "  ",
                    paste(supermatrix[i,], collapse="")), con)
}
writeLines(c("  ;", "end;", ""), con)

# ── 6. Write partition block ──────────────────────────────────────────

writeLines("begin sets;", con)
for (loc in names(partition_info)) {
  p <- partition_info[[loc]]
  writeLines(paste0("  charset ", loc, " = ", p$start, "-", p$end, ";"), con)
}

# Partition groups
mito_parts    <- names(partition_info)[sapply(partition_info, `[[`, "type") == "mtDNA"]
nuclear_parts <- names(partition_info)[sapply(partition_info, `[[`, "type") == "nuDNA"]

writeLines(paste0("  charpartition supermatrix = ",
                  paste(paste0("mtDNA:", mito_parts),    collapse=", "), ", ",
                  paste(paste0("nuDNA:", nuclear_parts), collapse=", "), ", ",
                  "Morphology:Morphology", ";"), con)
writeLines("end;", con)
close(con)

# ── 7. Write RAxML/IQ-TREE partition file ────────────────────────────

part_lines <- c()
for (loc in names(partition_info)) {
  p    <- partition_info[[loc]]
  type <- if (p$type == "mtDNA" || p$type == "nuDNA") "DNA" else "MULTI"
  part_lines <- c(part_lines,
                  paste0(type, ", ", loc, " = ", p$start, "-", p$end))
}
writeLines(part_lines,
           "~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/partitions.txt")

# ── 8. Summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\nPartition summary:\n")
for (loc in names(partition_info)) {
  p <- partition_info[[loc]]
  cat(sprintf("  %-12s %5d-%5d  (%d cols)  [%s]\n",
              loc, p$start, p$end, p$end - p$start + 1, p$type))
}
cat("\nFiles written to ~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SANITY CHECK SUPERMATRIX
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── 1. Read it back in ───────────────────────────────────────────────
lines <- readLines("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/supermatrix.nex")

# Basic structure
cat("Total lines:", length(lines), "\n")
cat("First 6 lines:\n")
cat(lines[1:6], sep="\n")

# ── 2. Check dimensions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
dim_line <- lines[grep("dimensions", lines, ignore.case=TRUE)]
cat("\nDimensions line:", dim_line, "\n")

# ── 3. Check all canonical taxa are present ──────────────────────────
taxa_in_matrix <- gsub("\\s+.*","", 
                        trimws(lines[grep("^  [A-Z]", lines)]))
cat("\nTaxa in matrix:", length(taxa_in_matrix), "\n")
missing_taxa <- canonical_taxa[!gsub(" ","_",canonical_taxa) %in% taxa_in_matrix]
if (length(missing_taxa) > 0) {
  cat("MISSING TAXA:", paste(missing_taxa, collapse=", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("All canonical taxa present ✓\n")
}

# ── 4. Check sequence lengths are all equal ──────────────────────────
seq_lines <- lines[grep("^  [A-Z]", lines)]
seq_lens  <- nchar(gsub("^  \\S+\\s+", "", seq_lines))
cat("\nSequence length range:", min(seq_lens), "-", max(seq_lens), "\n")
if (length(unique(seq_lens)) == 1) {
  cat("All sequences same length ✓\n")
} else {
  cat("LENGTH MISMATCH — check these taxa:\n")
  print(taxa_in_matrix[seq_lens != seq_lens[1]])
}

# ── 5. Check partitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
charset_lines <- lines[grep("charset", lines, ignore.case=TRUE)]
cat("\nPartitions:\n")
cat(charset_lines, sep="\n")

# ── 6. Check partition coverage — no gaps, no overlaps ───────────────
ranges <- lapply(charset_lines, function(l) {
  m <- regmatches(l, regexpr("\\d+-\\d+", l))
  if (length(m) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.integer(strsplit(m, "-")[[1]])
})
ranges <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ranges)

# Check contiguous
ends   <- sapply(ranges, `[`, 2)
starts <- sapply(ranges, `[`, 1)
gaps   <- starts[-1] - ends[-length(ends)] - 1
if (all(gaps == 0)) {
  cat("\nPartitions contiguous, no gaps ✓\n")
} else {
  cat("\nGAPS BETWEEN PARTITIONS at positions:",
      paste(which(gaps != 0), collapse=", "), "\n")
}

# Check total coverage
total_covered <- sum(sapply(ranges, function(r) r[2] - r[1] + 1))
cat("Total columns covered:", total_covered, "\n")
cat("Supermatrix ncol:     ", unique(seq_lens), "\n")
if (total_covered == unique(seq_lens)) {
  cat("Partition coverage matches supermatrix ✓\n")
} else {
  cat("PARTITION COVERAGE MISMATCH\n")
}

# ── 7. Check missing data per taxon ──────────────────────────────────
pct_missing <- sapply(seq_lines, function(l) {
  seq <- gsub("^  \\S+\\s+", "", l)
  chars <- strsplit(seq, "")[[1]]
  round(sum(chars %in% c("?","-")) / length(chars) * 100, 1)
})
names(pct_missing) <- taxa_in_matrix

cat("\nMissing data per taxon (%):\n")
print(sort(pct_missing))
cat("\nMean missing data:", round(mean(pct_missing), 1), "%\n")
cat("Max missing data: ", max(pct_missing), "% (", 
    names(pct_missing)[which.max(pct_missing)], ")\n")
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SPLIT SUPERMATRIX INTO MOLECULAR + MORPHO FOR BEAUTI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

lines     <- readLines("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/supermatrix_26taxa.nex")
seq_lines <- lines[grep("^  [A-Z]", lines)]

n_mol   <- partition_info[["Morphology"]]$start - 1
n_morph <- partition_info[["Morphology"]]$end - partition_info[["Morphology"]]$start + 1

# ── Molecular NEXUS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
con <- file("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/molecular_26taxa.nex", "w")
writeLines(c(
  "#NEXUS", "",
  "begin data;",
  paste0("  dimensions ntax=26 nchar=", n_mol, ";"),
  "  format datatype=dna interleave=no missing=? gap=-;",
  "  matrix"
), con)
for (l in seq_lines) {
  taxon <- gsub("\\s+.*", "", trimws(l))
  seq   <- trimws(gsub("^\\s*\\S+\\s+", "", l))
  mol_seq <- substr(seq, 1, n_mol)
  writeLines(paste0("  ", taxon, "  ", mol_seq), con)
}
writeLines(c("  ;", "end;", ""), con)

# Charset block — molecular only
writeLines("begin sets;", con)
for (loc in names(partition_info)) {
  if (loc == "Morphology") next
  p <- partition_info[[loc]]
  writeLines(paste0("  charset ", loc, " = ", p$start, "-", p$end, ";"), con)
}
writeLines("end;", con)
close(con)

# ── Morphology NEXUS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
con <- file("~/Downloads/Boxfish/supermatrix/morpho_26taxa.nex", "w")
writeLines(c(
  "#NEXUS", "",
  "begin data;",
  paste0("  dimensions ntax=26 nchar=", n_morph, ";"),
  "  format datatype=standard interleave=no missing=? gap=-;",
  "  matrix"
), con)
for (l in seq_lines) {
  taxon <- gsub("\\s+.*", "", trimws(l))
  seq   <- trimws(gsub("^\\s*\\S+\\s+", "", l))
  morph_seq <- substr(seq, n_mol + 1, n_mol + n_morph)
  writeLines(paste0("  ", taxon, "  ", morph_seq), con)
}
writeLines(c("  ;", "end;", ""), con)
close(con)

cat("Written:\n")
cat("  molecular_26taxa.nex —", n_mol, "chars\n")
cat("  morpho_26taxa.nex —", n_morph, "chars\n")
```

```{r}
translation <- do.call(rbind, lapply(trans_lines, function(l) {
  l <- trimws(gsub(",", "", l))
  parts <- strsplit(l, "\\s+")[[1]]
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]  # remove empty strings from leading whitespace
  data.frame(num = parts[1], name = parts[2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

# Verify
head(translation)

# Apply to last tree
last_tree <- trees[[length(trees)]]
last_tree$tip.label <- translation$name[match(last_tree$tip.label, translation$num)]
last_tree <- root(last_tree, "Triodon_macropterus", resolve.root = TRUE)
last_tree$tip.label <- gsub("_", " ", last_tree$tip.label)

ggtree(last_tree) +
  geom_tiplab(fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  xlim(0, 200) +
  labs(title = "BEAST chain 1 — last sampled tree")
# Check what tip labels look like after translation
last_tree$tip.label
head(translation)

trees[[length(trees)]]$tip.label
```
